categories.name: ORB Adapters
categories.shortDescription: Zinc-plated steel SAE O-ring boss (ORB) adapters: ORB × NPTF adapters and elbows, ORB × JIC and ORB × NPSM swivel elbows, unions, reducers, couplings and plugs, each with a full size table.
categories.seoTitle: ORB Adapters, SAE O-Ring Boss, Steel
categories.seoDescription: Steel SAE O-ring boss (ORB) adapters: ORB × NPTF adapters and elbows, JIC and NPSM swivel elbows, unions, reducers and plugs, with size tables.

hero.intro: SAE O-ring boss adapters in zinc-plated carbon steel, for straight-thread ports on pumps, valves and cylinders.

guidance.heading: Sealing an ORB port
guidance.body: An ORB port seals on an O-ring compressed under the hex, so the thread carries no sealant. Adjustable elbows and tees have a locknut, so the branch can be set to any angle before the O-ring is clamped. Fit a new O-ring whenever the joint is remade.

standards.heading: SAE J1926 and SAE J514
standards.body: The O-ring boss port is defined by SAE J1926 (ISO 11926); it shares its threads with the 37° JIC flare of SAE J514. Pipe-thread ends are NPTF to ASME B1.20.3.

items.q: Do the listings show part numbers and sizes?
items.a: Yes: every size has its own Indus part number, with the size and thread on each end; many also carry millimetre dimensions and the Parker equivalent the manufacturer cross-references.
Yes: Buna-N and Viton O-rings for ORB ports, by size, are listed under O-Rings for ORB & ORFS Adapters.

categories.name: Japanese JIS 30° Adapters
categories.shortDescription: Zinc-plated steel Japanese JIS 30° adapters to JIC, ORFS, ORB and BSPP, with JIS 30° plugs, caps, elbows, tees, a Komatsu adapter and BSPP-to-JIS seat converters.
categories.seoDescription: Steel JIS 30° adapters for Japanese machinery: JIS to JIC, ORFS, ORB and BSPP, plugs, caps, elbows, tees and seat converters, with size tables.

hero.intro: JIS 30° flare adapters in zinc-plated carbon steel, for joining Japanese-built machinery to JIC, ORFS, ORB and BSP lines.

guidance.heading: JIS 30° or BSP
guidance.body: A JIS 30° fitting has a BSP parallel thread with a 30° flare seat, so it threads onto a BSPP part but seals on the flare. Check the seat angle before ordering: a 30° seat does not seal against a 37° JIC or a 60° BSP cone.

standards.heading: Thread and seat
standards.body: The JIS 30° connection uses BSP parallel threads (ISO 228-1). The adapters' other ends follow SAE J514 (JIC), SAE J1453 (ORFS) and SAE J1926 (ORB).

items.q: Do the listings show part numbers and sizes?
items.a: Yes: every size has its own Indus part number, with the size and thread on each end; many also carry millimetre dimensions and the Parker equivalent the manufacturer cross-references.
One: a Komatsu M16×1.5 male to BSPT male adapter, listed under BSP adapters.

categories.name: O-Rings for ORB & ORFS Adapters
categories.shortDescription: Replacement O-rings for SAE O-ring boss ports and ORFS face seals, in Buna-N (NBR) and Viton (FKM), by fitting size, plus a 288-piece assortment kit.
categories.seoTitle: O-Rings for ORB & ORFS Hydraulic Adapters
categories.seoDescription: Replacement O-rings for ORB ports and ORFS face seals in Buna-N and Viton, sized by fitting, plus a 288-piece O-ring assortment kit.

hero.intro: Replacement O-rings for ORB ports and ORFS face seals, in Buna-N and Viton.

guidance.heading: Buna-N or Viton
guidance.body: Buna-N (NBR) suits petroleum hydraulic oils at normal temperatures. Viton (FKM) is chosen for higher temperatures and for fluids that attack NBR. Each listing gives the O-ring size for every fitting size.

standards.heading: Sizes
standards.body: ORB O-rings carry the 9xx size numbers used for straight-thread boss seals; ORFS O-rings carry the size the manufacturer gives for each face-seal size.

items.q: When should the O-ring be replaced?
items.a: Every time an ORB or ORFS joint is broken and remade, and whenever the O-ring is cut, flattened or hardened.

categories.seoTitle: Steel Hose Barb Adapters, Beaded Barb
categories.seoDescription: Steel beaded hose barb adapters: barb × NPTF male 90° and 45° elbows, barb × ORB male straights and elbows, and a hose mender tee.

hero.intro: Beaded hose barb adapters in zinc-plated steel, for push-on hose on low-pressure lines.

guidance.heading: Choosing a barb
guidance.body: Match the barb size to the hose inside diameter, then pick the thread end. A beaded barb holds push-on hose on low-pressure lines; check the hose rating and the medium before ordering.

standards.heading: Thread ends
standards.body: Pipe-thread ends are NPTF to ASME B1.20.3 and ORB ends are SAE J1926.

items.q: What pressure are they rated to?
items.a: The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for these barbs. Tell us the medium and working pressure and we will confirm the fitting before you order.

The Steel BSPP Test Port Tee, Male × Female Swivel × 1/8" BSP Port is a test port tee, in forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. Its ends are BSPP male, BSPP female swivel and BSP female. Construction

  • Body: test port tee
  • End 1: BSPP male
  • End 2: BSPP female swivel
  • End 3: BSP female
  • Material: forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated

Ends and sealing

  • BSPP: BSP parallel thread, sealed by a bonded seal, O-ring or cone seat rather than on the thread; ISO 228-1.
  • BSP: BSP female thread; the manufacturer does not say parallel or taper, so confirm the mating thread before ordering.

Sizes

How to order

products.descriptionLong:
The Steel Beaded Hose Barb × NPTF Male 90° Elbow is a 90° elbow, in forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. Its ends are beaded hose barb and NPTF (Dryseal) male. Beaded hose barbs take push-on hose on low-pressure lines; check the hose rating and the medium before ordering.

Construction

  • Body: 90° elbow
  • End 1: beaded hose barb
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) male
  • Material: forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated

Ends and sealing

products.descriptionShort: Steel NPTF Female × SAE Code 61 Flange Pad Adapter, forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. 19 part numbers, 1/2" to 3"; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Steel NPTF Female × SAE Code 61 Flange Pad Adapter is a flange pad adapter, in forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. Its ends are NPTF (Dryseal) female and SAE Code 61 flange pad. Flange pad adapters bolt to an SAE four-bolt flange port and turn it into a threaded port or tube end, on pumps, valves and manifolds.

Construction

  • Body: flange pad adapter
  • End 1: NPTF (Dryseal) female
  • End 2: SAE Code 61 flange pad
  • Material: forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated

Ends and sealing

  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.
  • SAE Code 61 flange pad: four-bolt flange pad that bolts to an SAE Code 61 port and seals on an O-ring; SAE J518 / ISO 6162-1.

Sizes

19 part numbers, 1/2" to 3". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/2" to 3" (1/2-14 to 3-8)
  • End 2: SAE Code 61 flange pad, 1/2" to 3"

Pressure rating

Manufacturer's published ratings (SAE J518 Code 61), from 2,000 to 3,000 psi depending on size:

Dash sizeNominal size (in)Bolt sizeCode 61 max. working pressure (psi)

The Steel ORB Female × NPTF Male Adapter is a straight adapter, in forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. Its ends are SAE O-ring boss (ORB) female and NPTF (Dryseal) male. O-ring boss ports are the standard straight-thread port on US-built pumps, valves and cylinders.

Construction

  • Body: straight adapter
  • End 1: SAE O-ring boss (ORB) female
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) male
  • Material: forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated
  • O-ring: NBR (Buna-N)

Ends and sealing

  • SAE O-ring boss (ORB): SAE straight-thread port sealed by an O-ring under the hex; SAE J1926 / ISO 11926.
  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

18 part numbers, 1/4" to 1-1/2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end, dimensions in millimetres and the Parker equivalent for every one.

  • End 1: SAE O-ring boss (ORB), 1/4" to 1-1/2" (7/16-20 to 1-7/8-12)
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 1-1/2" (1/8-27 to 1-1/2-11.5)

products.descriptionShort: Steel ORB Male × NPTF Female 90° Elbow, forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. 17 part numbers, 1/4" to 2"; the size table gives the size on each end for every Indus part number.
products.descriptionLong:
The Steel ORB Male × NPTF Female 90° Elbow is a 90° elbow, in forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. Its ends are SAE O-ring boss (ORB) male and NPTF (Dryseal) female. O-ring boss ports are the standard straight-thread port on US-built pumps, valves and cylinders.

Construction

  • Body: 90° elbow
  • End 1: SAE O-ring boss (ORB) male
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal) female
  • Material: forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated
  • O-ring: NBR (Buna-N)

Ends and sealing

  • SAE O-ring boss (ORB): SAE straight-thread port sealed by an O-ring under the hex; SAE J1926 / ISO 11926.
  • NPTF (Dryseal): Dryseal taper pipe thread, cut so the crests and roots close up as the joint is tightened, so it seals on the thread; ASME B1.20.3.

Sizes

17 part numbers, 1/4" to 2". The Sizes & Part Numbers tab lists the size on each end for every one.

  • End 1: SAE O-ring boss (ORB), 1/4" to 2" (7/16-20 to 2-1/2-12)
  • End 2: NPTF (Dryseal), 1/8" to 2" (1/8-27 to 2-11.5)

Pressure rating

The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for this family. Tell us the working pressure your line sees and we will confirm the fitting is rated for it before you order.

Stainless-steel version

The same configuration in 316 stainless steel: Stainless Steel ORB Male × NPT Female 90° Elbow.

How to order

Quote the Indus part number from the size table. If you only have the fitting, send the thread or tube size on each end, and Indus engineering will confirm the part number. Price and lead time are confirmed with the quotation.

The Steel ORB Male × NPSM Female Swivel 45° Elbow is a 45° elbow, in forged carbon steel, trivalent zinc plated. Its ends are SAE O-ring boss (ORB) male and NPSM female swivel. O-ring boss ports are the standard straight-thread port on US-built pumps, valves and cylinders.
